headline: A 2018 law names a post office in Converse, Texas, the "Converse Veterans Post Office Building."
what_it_does: The law gives an official name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 9155 Schaefer Road in Converse, Texas. It renames the building only and does not change how the post office runs or what services it offers. Official summaries of this kind describe the naming and nothing more.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 20, 2018.
